limitations: This source has no MR or registration object; fusion is not demonstrated.
This source has one plan; plan summation is not demonstrated.
RT-only capture opens an unchanged copy of the approved public RTPLAN in an isolated temporary folder without CT, structures or dose.
Percentage mode is shown without activating Apply globally or Default; no global preference write.
Tag values are redacted in display memory only. Copy controls are visible but clipboard actions are not performed.
DVH and derived surfaces are approximate previews, not clinical validation.

validation.intentionalHolds: Dose, DVH and tags include held states; CT scroll revisits integer slices.

captureDiagnostics: Native WPF offscreen composition failed during an intermediate capture. Affected sequences were fully recaptured in fresh processes using WPF software composition. Final 3D frames retain the actual Direct3D GPU readback; no geometry was substituted.
